cohort.selection_seed_rule: next unused sequential preregistration seed after 2026082701 identity and 2026082702 bootstrap seeds; fixed before any new candidate identity

country_declaration.provider_supported_definition: selected country alpha3 has exact simplified ADM0 blob in pinned gbOpen tree
country_declaration.unsupported_selected_country_rule: candidate is ineligible before final identity selection; never substitute a second country

decision.if_fail: retain as failed independent provider-eligible observability confirmation; no same-cohort retuning or second scientific run
decision.if_pass: validate only the tested evidence-adequacy/observability axis; do not promote the global candidate-patch extension

second_activation.primary_endpoint_positive: at least one qualifying 2021-2025 occurrence row in the same frozen country

execution.technical_rerun_rule: may only preserve an exact already-artifacted scientific object; no refreeze or reselection after outcomes are opened
